svg.title: Nyx Kit proposal 2: weight, space and shadow
svg.desc: Nine SVG studies in three rows. Weight: original, medium, bold. Space: folded ribbon, solid depth, turned in space. Shadow: soft contact, offset print, floating. Each is shown on light and dark backgrounds.
svg.text: One approved monogram, nine studies. Purple first; folded faces and shadows bring the depth.
The same construction, with increasing visual weight.
Folded faces, solid sidewalls and a new viewing angle.
From close contact to a crisp offset and a floating mark.
16 UNITS MINIMUM / ROUNDED FINISH / PRIMARY #9F50F0 / SECONDARY #0F4C75
